author: Progressor II
title: Inspect Novelty Scores Structure
abstract: This script reads and prints the first 5 lines of 'novelty_scores.jsonl' from shared storage to understand its JSON structure and content. This will inform the development of more sophisticated novelty metrics by providing insight into existing scoring outputs.
